"""Tests for phase1_pipeline — thermal materials feature engineering."""
import os, sys, pandas as pd, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
from phase1_pipeline import (
    fetch_thermal_candidates, build_feature_matrix, split_features_targets,
    save_dataset, run_full_pipeline, build_feature_pipeline
)


def test_fetch_thermal_candidates_import():
    """Function exists and has correct signature defaults."""
    assert callable(fetch_thermal_candidates)
    import inspect
    sig = inspect.signature(fetch_thermal_candidates)
    assert "api_key" in sig.parameters
    assert "max_results" in sig.parameters


def test_build_feature_matrix_dummy():
    raw = pd.DataFrame({
        "formula_pretty": ["BN", "SiC", "AlN"],
        "bulk_modulus_vrh": [200.0, 230.0, 210.0],
        "band_gap_ev": [4.5, 2.3, 3.2],
    })
    result = build_feature_matrix(raw, formula_col="formula_pretty")
    assert isinstance(result, pd.DataFrame)
    assert result.shape[0] == 3
    # Should have original cols + element fraction features (118 for full periodic table)
    feature_cols = [c for c in result.columns if c not in ["formula_pretty", "bulk_modulus_vrh", "band_gap_ev"]]
    assert len(feature_cols) >= 100  # rich feature set


def test_split_features_targets():
    raw = pd.DataFrame({
        "formula_pretty": ["BN", "SiC"],
        "material_id": ["mp-1", "mp-2"],
        "bulk_modulus_vrh": [200, 230],
        "band_gap_ev": [4.5, 2.3],
    })
    df = build_feature_matrix(raw, formula_col="formula_pretty")
    df["bulk_modulus_vrh"] = raw["bulk_modulus_vrh"].values
    df["band_gap_ev"] = raw["band_gap_ev"].values
    X, y = split_features_targets(df)
    assert list(y.columns) == ["bulk_modulus_vrh", "band_gap_ev"]
    assert "bulk_modulus_vrh" not in X.columns
    assert "band_gap_ev" not in X.columns
    assert X.shape[0] == 2
    assert y.shape[0] == 2


def test_save_dataset_creates_file():
    df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2], "b": [3, 4]})
    path = save_dataset(df, path="tests/temp_dataset.csv")
    assert os.path.exists(path)
    # Clean up
    if os.path.exists(path):
        os.remove(path)


def test_build_feature_pipeline_import():
    fp = build_feature_pipeline()
    assert fp is not None
    from matminer.featurizers.base import MultipleFeaturizer
    assert isinstance(fp, MultipleFeaturizer)


def test_full_pipeline_smoke():
    # End-to-end smoke using dummy data path — verifies exception handling and prints
    # Does NOT call MPRester (would require real API key); covers save + split
    raw = pd.DataFrame({
        "formula_pretty": ["BN", "SiC", "AlN"],
        "bulk_modulus_vrh": [200.0, 230.0, 210.0],
        "band_gap_ev": [4.5, 2.3, 3.2],
    })
    # Direct feature + split + save test (not full MPRester call)
    full_df = build_feature_matrix(raw, formula_col="formula_pretty")
    full_df["bulk_modulus_vrh"] = raw["bulk_modulus_vrh"].values
    full_df["band_gap_ev"] = raw["band_gap_ev"].values
    X, y = split_features_targets(full_df)
    dataset_path = save_dataset(full_df, path="tests/full_smoke.csv")
    assert os.path.exists(dataset_path)
    if os.path.exists(dataset_path):
        os.remove(dataset_path)
    assert X.shape[1] > 0
    assert y.shape[1] == 2
